description: の公共施設情報 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] (series on Tokyo Open Data Catalog) is a series of datasets listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by Tokyo Metropolitan Government (Open Data Catalog Site). 【港区】施設についての情報です。 都知事杯オープンデータ・ハッカソン「公立図書館情報」「スポーツ施設一覧」「都市公園一覧」のデータを含みます。. Coverage: Tokyo, Japan. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The datasets are filed under 2 publishers. It offers 26 resource(s) in csv, geojson. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
